synopsis: ISO 13766 is the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) standard for earth-moving machinery [f15250]. Chapter 3 specifies that ISO 16001:2017 requires EMC compliance with ISO 13766, a requirement repeated in the glossary for object detection systems on earth-moving machines [f2414, f13023, f15255, f15215]. The glossary explains this as a two-way requirement: electronics must neither emit radio interference that disturbs other equipment nor be disturbed by external interference [f15254]. The supplied facts agree on this requirement but do not identify an ISO 13766 edition or provide detailed test methods or acceptance thresholds [f2414, f13023, f15255, f15215, f15250, f15254].
